According to Bloomberg data, the company’s 5‑year credit default swap (CDS) – a contract that pays out if the borrower defaults – closed on Monday the 19th near 1,090 basis points, almost three times last year’s level. That implies roughly a 60% probability of default over the next five years.
This is market pricing, not a forecast. When default‑protection sellers become more nervous they charge higher fees, and the hedge cost is indeed steep.
The market’s worry is that CoreWeave is taking on massive debt to build data centers and then leasing the facilities to AI firms that are also burning cash.
Wall Street Skinny’s Kristen Kelly said bond investors bear all the downside risk but cannot share the upside, “so pricing has to reflect the corresponding risk.”

Siebert Financial’s chief investment officer Mark Malek was even more blunt on the same program, saying some AI stocks “honestly deserve to fall” and adding that he “won’t be adding aggressively at this time.”

However, not everyone thinks the decline will spread. A Bank of America Global Research report described last week’s sharp drop as a “position‑adjustment‑driven blip on the AI‑trading edge,” with the steepest falls seen in “high‑leverage stocks” like CoreWeave and Nebius (NBIS‑US), not the AI giants themselves.
Warning signs could reach more companies
Yet the canary in this mine may be sending a warning to a broader audience.

Monday’s new pressure was not limited to CoreWeave – its debt‑hedge cost has actually slipped slightly from last Friday’s peak, while Oracle’s (ORCL‑US) CDS rose to its highest level since at least 2021 and Meta (META‑US), Amazon (AMZN‑US), Alphabet (GOOGL‑US) and Microsoft (MSFT‑US) all posted multi‑month highs in their credit default swaps.
In other words, the credit market is beginning to spread risk premia to non‑fringe stocks.

For the equity market, the key number to watch is $59.25. Holding that level sustains the short‑squeeze‑trap pattern; bulls then need to retake Monday’s high around $66 before they can aim for the October 15 high near $70.
If the price keeps breaking below Tuesday’s low of $57.24, focus will shift back to the May 2025 low near $53. A breach would open a slide toward the historic low zone of $33‑$36.
Going forward, watch whether the stock price and the default‑protection pricing start to send a consistent signal. One of the two is currently getting it wrong.

items.title: 市場太悲觀了？富國銀行一年多來首亮買訊 看好美股反彈
items.title_en: Is the Market Too Pessimistic? Wells Fargo Issues First Buy Signal in Over a Year, Bullish on US‑Equity Rally
paras: 美股近期受AI投資疑慮與高油價衝擊，富國銀行(WFC-US)的市場情緒指標卻亮起2025年6月以來首次「買進」訊號，顯示投資人可能過度悲觀，股市回檔後已浮現吸引力。不過，該行預期，下一波領漲主角可能轉向大型雲端業者與基礎設施軟體公司，半導體股則可能持續區間震盪。
富國銀行首席股票策略師Ohsung Kwon領軍的團隊指出，歷史上這項指標發出買進訊號後，標普500指數未來三個月上漲的機率達89%，平均漲幅為6.5%。這是一項反向指標，近期訊號反映市場已出現「極度悲觀」情緒。
Kwon認為，投資人對AI融資、期中選舉與伊朗局勢的擔憂，可能已過度反映在市場情緒中。不過，在獲利成長放緩、流動性環境不利的情況下，仍須保持審慎。
截至周一收盤，標普500指數距離歷史高點僅下跌1.6%，但AI相關類股承受的賣壓明顯更重。隨著晶片需求疑慮再起，費城半導體指數自10月6日以來已下跌14%。大型AI企業將於本周與下周陸續公布財報，成為市場檢視成長前景的重要依據。
Kwon已在9月將科技類股評等由「加碼」調降至「中立」，部分原因是期中選舉前，資料中心建設面臨愈來愈多反對聲浪。如今情緒指標轉為買進訊號，並不代表他看好所有AI相關股票同步反彈，而是預期市場領漲結構將有所改變。
過去幾季，AI資本支出超出預期，往往能推升晶片股，但Kwon認為，這種模式未必能繼續成為後市上漲的主要理由。支出愈高，意味企業可能需要發行更多債券，進而排擠專注AI市場的新興雲端業者融資空間。
他指出，未來支撐股價的關鍵將是資本紀律，也就是企業能否更審慎配置投資、控制支出，大型雲端業者有望成為新的領漲族群。相較於單純追逐擴張規模，市場將更重視企業投資與財務管理的能力。
對AI基礎設施的中期前景，Kwon仍抱持正面看法。他認為，2027年將是支撐這個領域投資前景的關鍵，屆時獲利預料維持強勁，供需也將持續吃緊。
paras_en: US equities have recently been hit by AI‑investment doubts and high oil prices, yet Wells Fargo’s (WFC‑US) market‑sentiment indicator flashed a “buy” signal for the first time since June 2025, suggesting investors may be overly gloomy and that the market is gaining appeal after the pull‑back. The bank, however, expects the next rally leaders to shift toward large cloud providers and infrastructure‑software firms, with semiconductor stocks likely to remain in a range‑bound pattern.

The team led by Wells Fargo chief equity strategist Ohsung Kwon notes that historically, when this indicator issues a buy signal, the S&P 500 has an 89% chance of rising over the next three months, with an average gain of 6.5%. It is a contrarian gauge, and the recent signal reflects “extreme pessimism” in the market.

Kwon believes investors have over‑reacted to concerns about AI financing, the mid‑term elections and the situation in Iran, but cautions that a slowdown in earnings growth and a tougher liquidity environment still call for prudence.

As of Monday’s close, the S&P 500 was down only 1.6% from its all‑time high, yet AI‑related stocks faced noticeably heavier selling pressure. With renewed doubts over chip demand, the Philadelphia Semiconductor Index has fallen 14% since October 6. Large AI firms will release earnings this week and next, providing a key barometer for growth outlooks.

Kwon downgraded his rating on technology stocks from “overweight” to “neutral” in September, partly because data‑center construction faced growing opposition ahead of the mid‑term elections. The shift of the sentiment indicator to a buy signal does not mean he expects all AI‑related stocks to rebound together, but rather that the market’s leading‑stock structure is likely to change.

In recent quarters, AI capital spending has exceeded expectations and often lifted chip stocks, but Kwon doubts that this pattern will continue to drive future gains. Higher spending means companies may need to issue more bonds, which could crowd out financing for emerging cloud players focused on the AI market.

He points out that the key to supporting stock prices going forward will be capital discipline – whether firms can allocate investments more cautiously and control outlays – and that large cloud providers are poised to become the new rally leaders. Compared with a pure chase of scale, the market will place greater emphasis on a company’s investment acumen and financial‑management capability.

Regarding the medium‑term outlook for AI infrastructure, Kwon remains upbeat. He sees 2027 as a pivotal year for the sector’s investment case, expecting strong earnings and continued tight supply‑demand dynamics to underpin growth.

items.title: 木頭姐AI股換手 砸813萬美元加碼CoreWeave、減持Palantir
items.title_en: Cathie Wood's AI Stock Turnover: Adds $8.13 M to CoreWeave, Cuts Palantir
paras: 「木頭姐」伍德（Cathie Wood）旗下方舟投資（ARK Invest）10月19日公布最新ETF交易紀錄，持續加碼AI雲端運算公司CoreWeave(CRWV-US) ，單日買進約813萬美元，為當日最大買進交易。
伍德同時減碼Palantir(PLTR-US) 、Shopify(SHOP-US) 及生技公司Personalis(PSNL-US) ，合計賣出約1,137.7萬美元，並增持三家新興生技公司。
根據交易紀錄，ARK透過旗艦創新ETF(ARKK-US) 及新世代網路ETF(ARKW-US) ，合計買進CoreWeave股票132,498股，交易金額約813.41萬美元，延續過去一週持續增持的操作。
CoreWeave主要提供AI訓練與推論所需的雲端運算基礎設施。近期受AI資料中心融資成本上升，以及市場擔憂資本支出回報影響，該公司股價波動加劇，ARK仍持續擴大持股。
賣出方面，ARK當日最大一筆交易為透過基因體學ETF(ARKG-US) ，賣出生技公司Personalis股票284,063股，交易金額約444.56萬美元，延續先前多個交易日削減持股的操作。
ARK另賣出電商軟體公司Shopify股票20,755股，交易金額約351.84萬美元；減持數據分析與AI軟體公司Palantir股票18,349股，交易金額約341.35萬美元。
三家公司合計賣出金額約1,137.7萬美元，高於當日買進CoreWeave的金額。
此外，ARK透過金融科技ETF(ARKF-US) 賣出阿里巴巴(BABA-US) 200股，交易金額約2.18萬美元，並減持線上博弈業者DraftKings(DKNG-US) 股票500股，交易金額約9,450美元。
除了CoreWeave，ARK當日也增加對新興生技公司的投資，透過ARKG買進Iambic Therapeutics(IAM-US) 股票60,269股，交易金額約143.5萬美元；增持Scribe Therapeutics(SCTX-US) 股票19,856股，交易金額約39.87萬美元。
ARK另買進Freenome(PCSC-US) 股票4,835股，交易金額約5.68萬美元，延續先前多個交易日的增持趨勢。上述三家生技公司合計買進金額約189.05萬美元。
paras_en: On October 19, Cathie Wood’s ARK Invest released its latest ETF trading record, showing a continued increase in its stake in AI cloud‑computing firm CoreWeave (CRWV‑US), buying roughly $8.13 million worth in a single day – the largest purchase that day.

Wood also reduced holdings in Palantir (PLTR‑US), Shopify (SHOP‑US) and biotech firm Personalis (PSNL‑US), selling about $11.377 million in total, while adding positions in three emerging biotech companies.

According to the trade logs, ARK bought 132,498 shares of CoreWeave through its flagship Innovation ETF (ARKK‑US) and Next‑Generation Internet ETF (ARKW‑US), amounting to approximately $8.1341 million, continuing a week‑long buying streak.

CoreWeave provides the cloud‑computing infrastructure needed for AI training and inference. Recently, higher financing costs for AI data centers and market worries about capital‑expenditure returns have heightened the stock’s volatility, yet ARK kept expanding its stake.

On the sell side, ARK’s biggest single trade that day came via its Genomics ETF (ARKG‑US), off‑loading 284,063 shares of Personalis for about $4.4456 million, extending a multi‑day reduction in that holding.
ARK also sold 20,755 shares of e‑commerce software company Shopify for roughly $3.5184 million and trimmed 18,349 shares of data‑analytics and AI software firm Palantir for about $3.4135 million.
The three companies together accounted for about $11.377 million in sales, exceeding the amount spent on CoreWeave that day.

In addition, ARK’s FinTech ETF (ARKF‑US) sold 200 shares of Alibaba (BABA‑US) for roughly $21,800 and reduced its position in online gambling operator DraftKings (DKNG‑US) by 500 shares, a trade worth about $9,450.

Beyond CoreWeave, ARK increased its exposure to emerging biotech on the same day, buying 60,269 shares of Iambic Therapeutics (IAM‑US) through ARKG for about $1.435 million and adding 19,856 shares of Scribe Therapeutics (SCTX‑US) for roughly $398,700.
ARK also purchased 4,835 shares of Freenome (PCSC‑US) for about $56,800, continuing a multi‑day buying trend; the three biotech purchases total approximately $1.8905 million.

items.title: 〈財報前瞻〉AI砸錢能回本嗎？Meta支出估翻倍 Muse變現受考驗
items.title_en: Pre‑earnings outlook: Can AI spending pay off? Meta’s expenses may double, Muse monetization under test
paras: Meta(META-US)將於周三(21日)美股盤後公布第三季財報，龐大的人工智慧(AI)支出，以及個人助理Muse的採用情況將成為市場焦點。隨著公司加速擴建AI基礎設施，投資人期待看到新產品能否帶動營收，支撐長期成長並抵銷支出壓力。
執行長祖克柏(Mark Zuckerberg)正推動Meta拓展廣告以外的收入來源，陸續推出面向企業的AI產品與服務，以加強與OpenAI、Anthropic的競爭。提供訂閱方案的Muse助理與最新AI模型獲得正面反應，也提振投資人對公司AI策略的信心。
美國銀行(BAC-US)旗下研究部門分析師表示，近期AI產品發布強化了市場對Meta執行能力的信任，其調查也顯示，第三季廣告需求維持穩健。不過，Meta承諾投入數千億美元擴充AI基礎設施，財務負擔仍受到關注。
根據Visible Alpha資料，分析師預估Meta第三季資本支出將較去年同期增加逾一倍，達416.8億美元。支出攀升已在第二季壓縮自由現金流，市場預期第三季自由現金流將轉為淨流出85.2億美元。
儘管投資規模持續擴大，摩根士丹利(MS-US)分析師仍上調Meta的2027年與2028年獲利預估，理由是廣告業務成長更強勁，加上新AI產品具備創造額外營收的潛力。
短期而言，華爾街預期Meta獲利將承壓。根據LSEG彙整資料，第三季淨利估計年減約17%，至154.4億美元；營收則預估年增23.8%，達634.2億美元，但增速低於前一季的約28%，反映公司面臨Alphabet(GOOGL-US)旗下Google與TikTok的激烈競爭。
Meta股價今年以來上漲約7%，落後標普500指數約12%的漲幅。這次財報除了廣告業務表現，Muse的採用進展與AI產品變現能力，也將是投資人評估龐大支出能否帶來回報的重要依據。
paras_en: Meta (META‑US) will release its Q3 earnings after the U.S. market close on Wednesday (the 21st). The massive AI spending and the adoption of its personal assistant Muse will be market focal points. As the company accelerates the build‑out of AI infrastructure, investors are eager to see whether new products can drive revenue, support long‑term growth and offset spending pressure.

CEO Mark Zuckerberg is pushing Meta to expand revenue beyond advertising, rolling out AI products and services for enterprises to strengthen competition with OpenAI and Anthropic. The subscription‑based Muse assistant and the latest AI models have received positive feedback, bolstering investor confidence in the company’s AI strategy.

Analysts in Bank of America’s (BAC‑US) research division say recent AI product launches have reinforced market trust in Meta’s execution ability, and their survey shows Q3 ad demand remains solid. However, Meta’s pledge to invest hundreds of billions of dollars in expanding AI infrastructure keeps the financial burden in focus.

According to Visible Alpha data, analysts estimate Meta’s Q3 capital expenditures will more than double year‑over‑year to $41.68 billion. The spending surge already squeezed free cash flow in Q2, and the market expects Q3 free cash flow to turn into a net outflow of $8.52 billion.

Despite the expanding investment scale, Morgan Stanley (MS‑US) analysts have raised their profit forecasts for Meta in 2027 and 2028, citing stronger advertising growth and the potential of new AI products to generate additional revenue.

In the short term, Wall Street expects Meta’s earnings to be under pressure. LSEG‑compiled data projects Q3 net income to fall about 17% year‑over‑year to $15.44 billion, while revenue is forecast to rise 23.8% year‑over‑year to $63.42 billion, a slowdown from the roughly 28% growth seen in the prior quarter, reflecting fierce competition from Alphabet’s (GOOGL‑US) Google and TikTok.

Meta’s stock has risen roughly 7% year‑to‑date, lagging the S&P 500’s roughly 12% gain. This earnings report will be judged not only on ad performance but also on Muse’s adoption progress and the monetization capability of AI products, which are key indicators of whether the massive spending can deliver returns.

items.title: 馬斯克、Anthropic等AI巨頭為何大方送股？贈股兼顧公關形象與稅務優勢
items.title_en: Why AI Giants Like Musk and Anthropic Generously Give Away Stock: Balancing PR and Tax Benefits
paras: 幾位頂尖人工智慧(AI)企業的領導人最近不約而同披露，打算以各自的方式分享財富。美媒分析，這項大方的舉動有附帶好處，一方面可以做公關，另一方面也可讓自家企業享有稅務優勢。
馬斯克周日在社群平台X發文表示，他將「送給美國每個孩子一股SpaceX股票」，並在後續貼文中確認，將透過「川普帳戶」(Trump accounts)執行這項計畫。
馬斯克同時擔任SpaceX(SPCX-US)與特斯拉(TSLA-US)執行長，也是全球在世首富。根據《富比世》(Forbes)資料，他目前身價約9,220億美元。
美國財政部迄今已為兒童開設超過7,000萬個可遞延課稅的川普帳戶。年齡未滿18歲、持有有效社會安全號碼的美國人，均符合帳戶資格。美國今年7月正式推出這項計畫，多家大型企業已同意配對捐款，部分知名企業領袖也宣布投入資金。
例如，戴爾科技(DELL-US)執行長Michael Dell與妻子Susan Dell表示，將捐出62.5億美元投入川普帳戶。橋水基金創辦人達里歐(Ray Dalio)也承諾，將為康乃狄克州約30萬名兒童的帳戶各捐贈250美元。美國財政部一名官員表示，不計入馬斯克的承諾，川普帳戶自7月4日以來已收到超過80億美元存款。
與上述捐贈者不同，馬斯克計劃捐出股票，而非現金。美國財政部最近表示，已獲悉「有數名符合資格的捐贈者，原本不會以現金捐款，但已準備透過增值股票進行捐贈」。
根據SpaceX上周五收盤股價估算，若向美國約7,200萬名兒童各捐贈一股股票，馬斯克付出的價值約為105億美元。SpaceX長期營運長Gwynne Shotwell今年7月曾表示，她與丈夫將各自捐出一股SpaceX股票，投入200萬個帳戶。
Shotwell在聲明中說：「我們的職涯相當幸運，希望這份禮物能鼓勵下一代繼續努力，讓人類得以在星際間生活與飛行。」

捐贈增值股票可節稅 但投資集中風險仍在

對部分投資人而言，捐贈股票可能是明智的做法，尤其是持有大量股票的人。富達投資(Fidelity)指出，相較於現金捐贈，捐出增值的股票有可能提高個人的捐贈金額與稅務扣除效益。
Manna財富管理公司執行董事David Kassir說：「捐贈已增值的股票，是具有慈善意願的投資人能採取的最聰明做法之一。你可以避免出售股票時原本需要繳納的資本利得稅，通常也能按照股票的完整市值申報扣除，而慈善機構或帳戶則能收到全額價值。」
不過Kassir補充，持股過度集中仍可能令人擔憂。美國財政部曾表示，川普帳戶的受益人將承擔「額外的部分風險」，原因在於投資組合的集中程度較高。此外，投入川普帳戶的股票，必須持有滿五年才能出售。
馬斯克是SpaceX最大股東，持有普通股82.4%的投票權。他持有超過8.49億股A股，可能會從中撥出股票進行捐贈，同時也持有SpaceX絕大部分的B股。然而，依照SpaceX首次公開發行(IPO)的相關規定，馬斯克目前所有股票都處於閉鎖期，這代表他可能要到2027年6月才能捐贈。
若馬斯克兌現捐贈承諾，可能有助於改善他備受爭議的公眾形象。喬治城大學金融學教授Reena Aggarwal認為，把資金投入川普帳戶的做法值得肯定，因為這可能有助於低收入家庭。
Aggarwal指出，儘管馬斯克擁有巨額財富，但他並不以慈善家形象著稱。根據非營利的馬斯克基金會最近一次申報資料，該基金會2024年資產達147億美元，當年捐出4.74億美元，其中很大一部分流向一家非營利組織，該組織在馬斯克位於德州巴斯特羅普的企業附近經營一所學校。
馬斯克周一在X上回覆一則稱讚他「繞過」非營利組織等傳統捐贈管道的貼文時寫道：「直接把股票，也就是未來經濟的一部分，交給人民，才是正確的做法。」

Anthropic擬將5%股權投入公益公司

馬斯克宣布捐股的消息，似乎和Anthropic先前提出的計畫相呼應：該公司打算將相當大一部分股權捐給一家新成立的有限責任公司，藉此推動自身目標。
Anthropic表示，在取得股東批准後，將把5%的公司股權投入這家有限責任公司(LLC)。此後，每當公司估值比一個未公開的基準增加50%，董事會還可自行決定額外投入2%股權。
Anthropic表示，若加上許多員工及每位共同創辦人承諾捐出的部分股權，總計將有20%的公司股份「用於公共利益」。該公司舉例表示，相關工作包括研究並處理AI帶來的勞動市場不穩定問題。
Anthropic表示，設立有限責任公司將使公司比採用一般非營利組織模式擁有更大的彈性與規模。未來也可能考慮向非營利組織捐款，或直接向「特定族群」分配資金。
Anthropic在聲明中表示：「科技公司通常會逐步提高高階主管的薪酬獎勵。我們則選擇將這些股權用於公共利益。」
Anthropic正在籌備大型首次公開發行(IPO)，然而公眾對AI卻抱持日益不滿的情緒。
不過，研究IPO的Aggarwal認為，這家新成立的有限責任公司不太可能大幅改變投資人對Anthropic的看法。她指出，Anthropic本身就是一家公益公司，原本便以致力於協助社會聞名。
Aggarwal說：「歸根究柢，投資人最關注的仍將是Anthropic的估值、獲利能力及其他財務指標。」
paras_en: Several top artificial intelligence (AI) company leaders have recently disclosed, almost simultaneously, that they plan to share their wealth in their own ways. U.S. media analysis says this generous move carries added benefits: it serves as public relations and also gives the companies tax advantages.

Elon Musk posted on the social platform X on Sunday that he will "give every child in the United States one share of SpaceX stock," and later confirmed that the plan will be carried out through the "Trump accounts."
Musk is simultaneously the CEO of SpaceX (SPCX-US) and Tesla (TSLA-US) and is the world’s richest living person. According to Forbes, his net worth is currently about $922 billion.

The U.S. Treasury has so far opened more than 70 million tax‑deferred Trump accounts for children. Any U.S. person under 18 with a valid Social Security number qualifies. The program was officially launched in July, and several large corporations have agreed to match donations, with some prominent business leaders also announcing contributions.

For example, Dell Technologies CEO Michael Dell and his wife Susan said they will donate $6.25 billion to Trump accounts. Bridgewater founder Ray Dalio also pledged to give $250 to each of roughly 300,000 children in Connecticut. A Treasury official said that, not counting Musk’s pledge, the Trump accounts have received over $8 billion in deposits since July 4.

Unlike the donors above, Musk plans to donate stock rather than cash. The Treasury recently noted that it has learned of “several eligible donors who would not have contributed cash but are prepared to donate appreciated stock.”

Based on SpaceX’s closing price last Friday, donating one share to each of roughly 72 million U.S. children would be worth about $10.5 billion. SpaceX COO Gwynne Shotwell said in July that she and her husband will each donate one SpaceX share to 2 million accounts.
Shotwell said in a statement, "Our careers have been incredibly fortunate, and we hope this gift encourages the next generation to keep striving so humanity can live and fly among the stars."

Donating appreciated stock saves taxes, but concentration risk remains. For some investors, giving stock can be a smart move, especially for those holding large positions. Fidelity notes that, compared with cash gifts, donating appreciated shares can increase the donor’s contribution amount and tax‑deduction benefit.

David Kassir, executive director of Manna Wealth Management, said, "Donating already‑appreciated stock is one of the smartest things charitable‑minded investors can do. You avoid the capital‑gains tax you’d owe on a sale, you can usually claim a deduction based on the full market value, and the charity or account receives the entire amount."

However, Kassir added that over‑concentration of holdings can still be worrisome. The Treasury has warned that beneficiaries of Trump accounts will bear "additional risk" because the portfolio is highly concentrated. Moreover, stocks placed in the accounts must be held for five years before they can be sold.

Musk is SpaceX’s largest shareholder, holding 82.4% of voting rights through Class A shares—more than 849 million shares—and could allocate some of them for donation while also owning the bulk of the B shares. However, under SpaceX’s IPO lock‑up rules, all his shares are currently restricted, meaning he may not be able to donate until June 2027.

If Musk follows through on his pledge, it could help improve his controversial public image. Reena Aggarwal, a finance professor at Georgetown University, says that putting money into Trump accounts is commendable because it may aid low‑income families.

Aggarwal notes that, despite Musk’s massive wealth, he is not known as a philanthropist. The most recent filing of the nonprofit Musk Foundation shows it held $14.7 billion in assets in 2024 and gave away $474 million that year, much of which went to a nonprofit that runs a school near Musk’s Texas‑based Basterrop facilities.

When Musk replied on X on Monday to a post praising his “bypassing” of traditional nonprofit channels, he wrote, "Giving the stock—essentially a piece of the future economy—directly to the people is the right thing to do."

Anthropic plans to put 5% of its equity into a public‑benefit company. Musk’s stock‑donation news seems to echo Anthropic’s earlier proposal: the firm intends to donate a sizable portion of its equity to a newly formed limited‑liability company to advance its mission.

Anthropic said that, after shareholder approval, it will place 5% of its equity into the LLC. Thereafter, whenever the company’s valuation rises 50% above an undisclosed baseline, the board may elect to contribute an additional 2% of equity.

Anthropic added that, including contributions from many employees and each co‑founder’s pledged shares, a total of 20% of the company’s stock would be earmarked “for the public benefit.” The firm cited work such as researching and addressing AI‑driven labor‑market instability.

Anthropic explained that using an LLC gives the company more flexibility and scale than a traditional nonprofit structure. In the future it may also consider donating to nonprofits or directly allocating funds to “specific groups.”
In its statement, Anthropic said, "Tech companies usually raise executive compensation over time. We choose to allocate those shares to the public benefit."
Anthropic is preparing for a large initial public offering, even as public sentiment toward AI grows increasingly negative.

However, Aggarwal, who studies IPOs, believes the newly formed LLC is unlikely to dramatically shift investors’ views of Anthropic. She points out that Anthropic is already positioned as a public‑benefit company known for its social‑impact mission.
Aggarwal concluded, "At the end of the day, investors will still focus on Anthropic’s valuation, profitability and other financial metrics."

items.title: AI設備商好日子快到頭？巴克萊示警價格、銷量恐雙雙承壓
items.title_en: Are Good Times for AI Equipment Makers Coming to an End? Barclays Warns Prices and Sales May Both Face Pressure
paras: AI資料中心建設熱潮帶動電力設備商獲利攀升，但這段好光景可能正接近高峰。巴克萊(BCS-US)分析師警告，隨著大型AI業者更加重視投資回報，加上設備供應競爭升溫，相關廠商恐同時面臨價格與銷量壓力，近年享有的超額獲利可能逐步回歸常態。
資料中心快速擴建，需要大量電力基礎設施，將電網電力輸送至AI伺服器，西門子能源(SMERY-US)、ABB(ABBNY-US)與施耐德電機(SBGSY-US)等業者因此受惠，享有一段高報酬時期。
不過，以George Featherstone為首的巴克萊分析師團隊指出，產業在景氣高峰時享有的獲利條件，可能很快恢復正常。當AI業者開始追求更高獲利能力，設備供應商之間的競爭又更加激烈，價格與銷量若同步受壓，將構成業者「最糟的情境」。
AI相關交易周二(20日)再度轉弱，延續近期回檔，投資人持續質疑龐大支出熱潮還能維持多久。西門子能源股價已較4月高點下跌31%，接近1月以來低點；施耐德電機較8月高點下跌22%，ABB自6月高點以來也有類似跌幅。
近幾周，市場對Anthropic成長放緩的疑慮，以及CoreWeave(CRWV-US)等新興AI雲端業者的信用風險，均打擊投資人信心。巴克萊表示，隨著投資回報受到更嚴格檢視、融資成本近期上升，已有跡象顯示，前沿AI實驗室與超大規模雲端業者開始向供應鏈施加議價壓力，對近年獲利格外豐厚的設備商不利。
分析師以Nscale與Anthropic洽談中的算力供應協議為例，這筆交易潛在價值約450億美元。若以每GW、每年的價格衡量，報價明顯低於近期市場基準，例如CoreWeave於9月揭露的短期合約。
巴克萊也強調，兩者合約條件不同，不能直接等同比較，但價格落差仍透露出訊號：供應鏈不能再假設自己能持續漲價、擴大利潤率，客戶正要求重新檢視交易條件。
競爭加劇則是另一項挑戰。分析師指出，產業過於優渥的報酬吸引愈來愈多新進業者加入，電力設備與中壓電氣設備尤其出現大規模擴產，而這兩個領域先前都曾因供應吃緊，導致交貨時間大幅拉長。
隨著新增產能陸續開出、客戶議價態度轉強，資料中心設備商能否維持高峰期的定價能力與獲利水準，將成為市場接下來的觀察重點。
paras_en: The AI data‑center construction boom has lifted profits for power‑equipment vendors, but that bright spell may be nearing its peak. Barclays (BCS‑US) analysts warn that as large AI players focus more on investment returns and equipment‑supply competition heats up, related manufacturers could face simultaneous price and volume pressure, and the excess profits enjoyed in recent years may gradually revert to normal levels.

Rapid data‑center expansion requires massive power infrastructure to deliver grid electricity to AI servers, benefitting companies such as Siemens Energy (SMERY‑US), ABB (ABBNY‑US) and Schneider Electric (SBGSY‑US), which have enjoyed a period of high returns.

However, a Barclays analyst team led by George Featherstone says the profit conditions the industry enjoys at the peak of the cycle may soon normalize. When AI firms start demanding higher profitability, competition among equipment suppliers intensifies, and if both price and volume are squeezed, it would create the firms’ “worst‑case scenario.”

AI‑related stocks weakened again on Tuesday (the 20th), continuing a recent pullback as investors keep questioning how long the massive spending spree can be sustained. Siemens Energy’s share price is down 31% from its April high, near its lowest level since January; Schneider Electric is down 22% from its August peak, and ABB has seen a similar decline since its June high.

In recent weeks, market doubts about Anthropic’s slowing growth and credit‑risk concerns around emerging AI cloud players such as CoreWeave (CRWV‑US) have dented investor confidence. Barclays notes that with investment returns under tighter scrutiny and financing costs rising, there are signs that frontier AI labs and hyperscale cloud providers are beginning to press the supply chain for better pricing, which is unfavorable for equipment makers that have enjoyed unusually high profits in recent years.

Analysts cite a compute‑capacity supply agreement under negotiation between Nscale and Anthropic as an example; the deal’s potential value is about $45 billion. Measured on a per‑GW‑per‑year basis, the pricing is clearly below recent market benchmarks, such as the short‑term contract CoreWeave disclosed in September.

Barclays also stresses that the two contracts differ and cannot be compared directly, but the price gap still signals that the supply chain can no longer assume it can keep raising prices and expanding margins, as customers are demanding a reassessment of terms.

Increasing competition is another challenge. Analysts note that the industry’s generous returns have attracted more newcomers, leading to large‑scale expansion in power‑equipment and medium‑voltage electrical gear, both of which previously suffered tight supply and significantly lengthened delivery times.

As new capacity comes online and customers become tougher negotiators, whether data‑center equipment makers can maintain peak‑period pricing power and profit levels will be a key focus for the market going forward.

items.title: 法國債市風暴會蔓延？貝森特不擔心 稱資金正轉向美債避險
items.title_en: Will the French Bond Market Turmoil Spread? Besson Not Worried, Says Capital Shifting to U.S. Treasuries for Safety
paras: 美國財政部長貝森特周二(20日)表示，不預期法國債市動盪會引發外溢衝擊，並指出部分投資人正將資金轉向美國公債避險。他也認為，隨著能源價格衝擊消退，美國房貸利率可望下降，政府則打算於明年或後年推進房利美與房地美脫離政府接管的計畫。
貝森特接受2Way訪問時表示，法國面臨棘手局面，但他熟識總統馬克宏的經濟團隊，認為其能力一流。他強調，不預期法國目前的情況會向外蔓延。

法德利差擴大 美債吸引避險資金

法國近幾周抗議不斷，上周末衝突進一步升高，暴力程度令政府措手不及，也加重法國公債壓力。在政府難以控制預算赤字之際，法債表現持續落後其他同類市場。
投資人對法國債務前景的疑慮，推升持有法債所要求的風險溢酬。法國10年期公債相對較安全德國公債的殖利率利差，本月一度擴大至159個基點。
貝森特表示，美方並未將這類動盪納入規畫，但確實看到資金撤離部分更令人擔憂的國家，轉向美國公債等較安全資產。
不過，自上月底法國局勢惡化以來，法債波動已數度牽動美債，時而帶動兩國債券價格同步下跌，時而促使避險資金流入美國。
美國10年期公債殖利率目前已較10月初高點回落約20個基點。當時能源價格居高不下，加上大型企業為AI需求擴大發債，曾推升殖利率至逾20年高點。
貝森特重申，他認為川普任內美國債市相較同類市場的表現全球最佳，並稱近20年來最強勁的公債標售中，有四次出現在這段期間。

房貸利率仍逾7% 兩房脫離接管最快明年推進

儘管美債殖利率自高點回落，偏高的利率仍壓抑房市。美國房貸利率以10年期公債殖利率為重要參考，借貸成本再度升至明顯高於7%的水準。周二公布的數據顯示，9月成屋待完成銷售降至2001年有紀錄以來最低。
美伊戰爭推升能源價格，也是美債殖利率居高不下的原因。貝森特表示，美國終將度過這波能源衝擊，屆時房貸利率應會下降。
他認為，現行立法措施也將提供協助，包括國會近期通過、限制機構投資人進入部分住宅市場的住房方案。
至於房利美與房地美這兩家房貸融資巨頭，川普政府已表明，希望結束政府接管。貝森特表示，政府正考慮於明年或後年採取行動，但未進一步說明具體安排。
此外，貝森特也談及個人生涯規畫，表示無意競選更高公職，並打算留任財政部長，直到川普任期結束。
paras_en: U.S. Treasury Secretary Besson said on Tuesday (the 20th) that he does not expect the turbulence in the French bond market to trigger spillover effects, noting that some investors are moving money into U.S. government bonds for safety. He also believes that as the shock from energy prices fades, U.S. mortgage rates should fall, and the government plans to advance the plan to unwind Fannie Mae and Freddie Mac’s government conservatorship next year or the year after.

In a 2Way interview, Besson said France faces a tricky situation, but he knows President Macron’s economic team well and considers them top‑notch. He stressed that he does not expect France’s current situation to spread outward.

The France‑Germany yield spread has widened, drawing safe‑haven flows into U.S. Treasuries. France has seen continuous protests in recent weeks, and last weekend the clashes intensified, catching the government off guard and adding pressure to French sovereign debt. With the government struggling to control its budget deficit, French bonds have lagged behind peers.

Investor doubts about France’s debt outlook have pushed up the risk premium demanded for holding French bonds. The yield spread between France’s 10‑year sovereign bond and the relatively safer German 10‑year bond briefly widened to 159 basis points this month.
Besson said the U.S. has not built this kind of turmoil into its planning, but it does see capital fleeing some more concerning countries and flowing into safer assets such as U.S. Treasuries.

Since the end of last month when the French situation deteriorated, French bond volatility has repeatedly affected U.S. Treasuries, sometimes causing both markets’ prices to fall together and sometimes prompting safe‑haven money to flow into the United States.

The yield on the U.S. 10‑year Treasury has fallen about 20 basis points from its early‑October peak. At that peak, energy prices were still high and large corporations were issuing debt to meet AI demand, pushing yields to a more than 20‑year high.

Besson reiterated that, in his view, the U.S. bond market has performed the best globally among comparable markets during the Trump administration, and that four of the strongest sovereign‑bond auctions in the past 20 years occurred in this period.

Mortgage rates remain above 7%, and the exit of Fannie Mae and Freddie Mac from conservatorship is expected to move forward as early as next year. Although Treasury yields have retreated from their peak, rates are still high enough to weigh on the housing market. U.S. mortgage rates, which track the 10‑year Treasury, have risen again to clearly above 7%. Data released on Tuesday showed that pending home sales for September fell to the lowest level since records began in 2001.

The U.S.–Iran conflict has pushed up energy prices, which is another reason Treasury yields stay elevated. Besson said the United States will eventually get past this energy shock, after which mortgage rates should decline.

He added that existing legislative measures will also help, including a housing program recently passed by Congress that limits institutional investors’ access to certain segments of the residential market.

Regarding the two mortgage‑finance giants, Fannie Mae and Freddie Mac, the Trump administration has signaled its desire to end the government conservatorship. Besson said the government is considering action next year or the year after, but gave no further details on the plan.
Besson also spoke about his personal career plans, saying he has no intention of running for higher office and intends to remain Treasury secretary until the end of the Trump administration.

items.title: 把省錢方法公開！DeepSeek推DeepInfer 企業有望更便宜跑AI
items.title_en: Publicizing Cost‑Saving Methods! DeepSeek Launches DeepInfer, Enabling Enterprises to Run AI More Cheaply
paras: 中國AI業者DeepSeek周二(20日)宣布，開源用於大規模運行旗下模型的軟體DeepInfer，讓企業、雲端與模型代管業者有機會採用其降低運算成本的方法。這套工具旨在加快模型運行速度、提高運算資源使用效率，但目前尚無獨立效能測試，能驗證其實際改善幅度。
總部位於杭州的DeepSeek在社群平台X表示，公開這套實際用於營運的軟體系統，是希望協助開發社群降低運算成本、減少能源消耗，讓AI更容易負擔。DeepInfer目前支援DeepSeek的V4.1-Flash模型，未來將陸續支援後續推出的系統。
這次開源的重點，在於AI模型訓練完成後，實際處理使用者要求、產生回答的「推論」階段。相同模型即使執行相同任務，採用不同軟體運行，成本也可能相差甚遠；更有效率的系統能降低每次請求所需的運算資源，並有望減少耗電。
DeepInfer整合多種技術，包括將運算工作分散至不同硬體的「分散式推論」，讓模型在較短時間內產生更多內容，並提高晶片使用效率。這些底層技術不少已被廣泛採用，但DeepSeek針對自家模型進行調整，使各項技術能更有效率地協同運作。
AI公司通常不會完整公開實際營運中的最佳化方法。DeepInfer的釋出，讓外界得以進一步了解DeepSeek如何控制先進AI模型的運行成本，也讓提供其模型服務的雲端與代管業者，有機會自行部署這些技術。
若推論成本下降，模型代管業者的利潤率可能改善，也可能將部分節省反映在客戶價格上。對希望在自有設備上運行DeepSeek模型的企業而言，DeepInfer則提供另一條降低成本的途徑。不過，實際效益仍有待測試，不能直接視為服務價格必然下降。
雖然DeepInfer主要針對DeepSeek自家模型設計，其他開發者仍可研究其開源程式碼，並將適用技術調整後導入自己的推論系統。這也讓此次發布的影響，有機會延伸至DeepSeek生態系以外。
paras_en: DeepSeek announced on Tuesday the 20th that it is open‑sourcing DeepInfer, software for large‑scale operation of its models, giving enterprises, cloud and model‑hosting providers a chance to adopt its cost‑reduction method. The tool aims to speed up model execution and improve compute resource efficiency, but there are no independent performance tests yet to verify the actual improvement.

Headquartered in Hangzhou, DeepSeek said on X that releasing the software actually used in production is intended to help the developer community lower compute costs and energy consumption, making AI more affordable. DeepInfer currently supports DeepSeek’s V4.1‑Flash model and will gradually support future releases.

The open‑source focus is on the inference stage, where the trained AI model processes user requests and generates answers. Even with the same model and task, using different software can lead to vastly different costs; a more efficient system can reduce the compute resources required per request and potentially cut power usage.

DeepInfer integrates multiple techniques, including “distributed inference” that spreads compute work across different hardware, allowing the model to produce more content in a shorter time and improve chip utilization. Many of these low‑level technologies are already widely used, but DeepSeek has tuned them for its own models so they work together more efficiently.

AI companies usually do not fully disclose the optimizations used in production. The release of DeepInfer lets outsiders see how DeepSeek controls the operating cost of its advanced AI models and gives cloud and hosting providers that offer its models the opportunity to deploy the techniques themselves.

If inference costs drop, model‑hosting providers’ profit margins could improve and they might pass some savings on to customers. For enterprises that want to run DeepSeek models on their own hardware, DeepInfer offers another cost‑saving path. However, the actual benefit remains to be tested and cannot be assumed to automatically lower service prices.

Although DeepInfer is primarily designed for DeepSeek’s own models, other developers can study the open‑source code and adapt the applicable techniques into their own inference systems. This gives the release the potential to impact beyond the DeepSeek ecosystem.

items.title: 想跟上蘋果又嫌貴？這套選擇權策略能降成本 但風險不能省略
items.title_en: Want to Keep Up with Apple but Find It Expensive? This Options Strategy Can Lower Costs, Though Risks Remain
paras: 蘋果(AAPL-US)新產品與AI功能帶動市場期待，但股價已反映不少利多，讓想參與後續漲勢的投資人面臨估值偏高的難題。《CNBC》一篇選擇權策略分析提出，透過買進較長天期買權、賣出較短天期買權與賣權，可降低買進買權的初始成本。不過，降低權利金支出並不等於降低整體風險，策略仍涉及承接股票、履行交割義務與保證金需求。

硬體新品與AI助攻 現金流成支撐

蘋果市值近期首度突破5兆美元，正逼近輝達(NVDA-US)的全球市值龍頭地位。市場關注焦點之一，是首款摺疊手機iPhone Duo的需求。蘋果形容，上周五開放預購後，買氣「非同凡響」，部分機型預估交貨時間在短短幾分鐘內就延至明年1月底。
除了Duo，智慧家庭中樞HomeView、新款MacBook Pro、搭載OLED螢幕的iPad，以及數周前推出的Mac Studio與相關晶片，也讓蘋果硬體產品重新吸引投資人目光。
軟體方面，Apple Intelligence深度整合升級版Siri與視覺智慧功能，使蘋果進一步參與AI成長題材。相較於其他大型科技公司，蘋果的資本支出規模較低，也讓其現金流表現受到關注。
文章引述預估指出，蘋果2027會計年度營收可望超過5,000億美元，息稅折舊攤銷前利益(EBITDA)超過1,800億美元，資本支出則約135億美元，自由現金流預估達1,560億美元。截至6月27日止季度，蘋果公布的淨現金約為620億美元。

估值已反映利多 選擇權權利金也偏高

不過，強勁產品陣容與現金流並不代表股價便宜。以2027會計年度每股獲利預估9.59美元計算，蘋果預估本益比接近36倍，明顯高於長期平均。
文章指出，當市值達到5兆美元，要進一步推動股價上漲，需要更大幅度的營收驚喜，而這愈來愈難達成。因此，即使基本面具支撐，偏高估值仍可能限制短期漲幅。
蘋果選擇權的權利金也高於平均水準。對買方而言，這代表布局成本偏高；但若搭配賣出短天期選擇權，收取的權利金便能抵銷部分長天期買權成本。

用短天期權利金降低成本 仍須承擔雙向風險

文章提出的策略，是買進明年2月到期、履約價360美元的買權，同時賣出今年12月到期、履約價310美元的賣權，以及同月到期、履約價375美元的買權。
理想情況是，蘋果股價在12月到期時維持於310至375美元之間，使兩筆賣出的選擇權失去價值，投資人保留收取的權利金，降低持有2月買權的淨成本。之後若股價上漲，長天期買權便有機會受惠。
不過，2月到期時股價高於360美元，只代表買權具有履約價值，整體交易是否獲利，仍須計入淨權利金、交易費用與先前履約情況。原文未提供實際成交權利金，因此無法計算確切損益兩平點。
下跌風險同樣不可忽略。賣出310美元賣權，意味投資人可能被要求以每股310美元承接股票，即使屆時市價已明顯低於該水準，並可能面臨額外保證金需求。
若股價提前大漲、突破375美元，賣出的12月買權也可能產生虧損或遭指派交割。雖然持有2月買權可提供部分抵銷，但兩者到期日不同，不能直接視為同月到期、風險固定的買權價差。
這項策略的核心，是利用短期權利金降低長期看漲部位的成本；代價則是增加履約義務與部位管理難度，並非以折扣價買進蘋果股票的簡單替代方案。
本文介紹的選擇權策略僅供參考，不構成投資建議。選擇權交易涉及槓桿、保證金及履約風險，降低權利金成本不代表降低整體風險，損失可能超過初始投入。投資人應審慎評估自身風險承受能力，並自行承擔交易損益。
paras_en: Apple (AAPL-US) new products and AI features are driving market expectations, but the stock price has already priced in many positives, leaving investors who want to participate in further upside facing a valuation that may be too high. A CNBC options‑strategy analysis suggests that buying longer‑dated calls while selling shorter‑dated calls and puts can reduce the initial cost of the long call. However, lowering the premium outlay does not equal a reduction in overall risk; the strategy still involves holding the stock, meeting delivery obligations and margin requirements.

Hardware new products and AI assistance underpin cash flow. Apple’s market value recently broke the $5 trillion mark for the first time, closing in on Nvidia (NVDA-US) as the world’s largest‑valued company. One focus of the market is the demand for the first foldable iPhone, the iPhone Duo. Apple said that after opening pre‑orders last Friday, demand was “extraordinary,” with some models’ estimated delivery times extending from a few minutes to the end of January next year.

Beyond the Duo, the HomeView smart‑home hub, the new MacBook Pro, an iPad with an OLED screen, and the Mac Studio and its associated chips launched a few weeks ago have all refocused investor attention on Apple’s hardware lineup.

On the software side, Apple Intelligence deeply integrates an upgraded Siri and visual‑intelligence features, further involving Apple in the AI growth theme. Compared with other large tech firms, Apple’s capital‑expenditure scale is relatively low, which also draws attention to its cash‑flow performance.

The article cites estimates that Apple’s fiscal 2027 revenue could exceed $500 billion, EBITDA over $180 billion, capital expenditures around $13.5 billion, and free cash flow about $156 billion. As of the quarter ending June 27, Apple reported net cash of roughly $62 billion.

Valuation already reflects the positives, and options premiums are also high. Yet, strong product line‑up and cash flow do not make the stock cheap. Using the fiscal‑2027 earnings‑per‑share estimate of $9.59, Apple’s implied P/E would be close to 36×, clearly above its long‑term average.

The article notes that once market cap reaches $5 trillion, further price appreciation will require larger revenue surprises, which become increasingly difficult to achieve. Therefore, even with solid fundamentals, a lofty valuation may limit short‑term upside.

Apple’s options premiums are above average. For buyers, this means higher positioning costs; however, selling short‑dated options can generate premium income that offsets part of the long‑dated call cost.

The proposed strategy involves buying a call expiring in February 2025 with a $360 strike, while simultaneously selling a put expiring in December 2024 with a $310 strike and selling a call expiring the same month with a $375 strike.

Ideally, Apple’s price at the December expiration would stay between $310 and $375, causing the two sold options to expire worthless, allowing the investor to keep the collected premiums and lower the net cost of holding the February call. If the price then rises, the long‑dated call could benefit.

However, if the price at the February expiration is above $360, the call merely has intrinsic value; overall profitability still depends on net premiums received, transaction costs and any prior exercise outcomes. The original article did not provide actual premium figures, so a precise breakeven cannot be calculated.

Downside risk cannot be ignored either. Selling the $310 put means the investor could be assigned stock at $310 per share even if the market price is well below that level, potentially triggering additional margin requirements.

If the price jumps early and exceeds $375, the sold December call could also incur a loss or be assigned for delivery. While the February call offers some hedge, the differing expirations mean the positions cannot be treated as a simple same‑month spread with fixed risk.

The core of this strategy is using short‑term premium income to lower the cost of a long‑term bullish position; the trade‑off is added exercise obligations and position‑management complexity, making it far from a simple discounted‑stock purchase alternative.

The options strategy described is for reference only and does not constitute investment advice. Options trading involves leverage, margin and exercise risk; reducing premium cost does not reduce overall risk, and losses can exceed the initial outlay. Investors should carefully assess their risk tolerance and bear any trading gains or losses themselves.

items.title: CoreWeave違約避險成本飆至近3倍 當心股價「誘空陷阱」
items.title_en: CoreWeave Default Hedge Cost Soars to Nearly Triple – Beware a “Short‑Squeeze Trap” in the Stock
paras: 股票交易員正逢低買進 CoreWeave(CRWV-US) ，債券交易員卻已將其違約機率達六成的風險反映在價格中。
CoreWeave股價於週二(20日)早盤跌至 2025 年 5 月以來新低，延續了自 10 月 6 日以來暴跌逾 40% 的走勢。隨後買盤進場，帶動股價回升至週一低點 59.25 美元上方。
這波反轉具備形成「空頭陷阱」的條件，也就是股價跌破支撐後迅速回升，讓押注續跌的交易員蒙受損失。不過，股價必須收在 59.25 美元之上，才能確認這個訊號。
CoreWeave 債務的違約保險成本，透露出更悲觀的訊息。
根據彭博數據，該公司5年期信用違約交換（CDS），即借款人違約時支付賠償的合約，週一(19日)收在接近 1,090 個基點，幾乎是前一年水準的3倍。根據計算，這隱含未來五年內約 60% 的違約機率。
這是市場定價，並非預測。違約保險賣方在擔憂升高時，會收取額外費用，但這樣的避險成本確實高昂。
市場擔心的是，CoreWeave 為興建資料中心而大舉舉債，再將設施出租給同樣持續燒錢的 AI 公司。
Wall Street Skinny 的 Kristen Kelly 表示，債券投資人承擔所有下行風險，卻無法分享上行利益，「因此，定價必須反映相應風險」。
Siebert Financial 首席投資長 Mark Malek 在同場節目中的說法更為直接。他表示部分 AI 股票「老實說下跌有理」，並補充自己「不會在此時大力加碼」。
不過，並非所有人都認為跌勢將蔓延。美銀全球研究一份報告將上周重挫形容為「部位調整引發、發生在 AI 交易邊緣的小波折」，跌勢最猛烈的是 CoreWeave 與 Nebius(NBIS-US) 等「高槓桿股票」，而非 AI 巨頭。
警訊可能擴及更多企業
然而，這隻礦坑中的金絲雀警訊可能正在向更廣泛的受眾傳遞。
週一的新壓力並非僅顯現於 CoreWeave，其債務避險成本實際上已自上週五的高點微幅回落；相反地，甲骨文(ORCL-US) 的 CDS 升至至少 2021 年以來的最高點，而 Meta(META-US) 、亞馬遜(AMZN-US) 、Alphabet(GOOGL-US) 及微軟(MSFT-US) 的信用違約交換也都創下數月來新高。
換言之，信用市場已開始將風險溢價擴及至非邊緣個股。
就股市而言，需關注的關鍵數字是 59.25 美元。守住此價位能維持空頭陷阱的格局，多頭接著需要收復週一高點 66 美元附近，才能進一步挑戰 10 月 15 日的高點 70 美元附近。
若持續跌破週二低點 57.24 美元，市場焦點將重回 2025 年 5 月接近 53 美元的低點；一旦失守，下方將進入 33 至 36 美元的歷史低檔區間。
接下來要觀察，股價與違約保險的走勢是否開始傳遞一致訊號。目前，兩者之中有一方判斷錯了。
paras_en: Stock traders are buying CoreWeave (CRWV-US) on the dip, while bond traders have already priced in a 60% default risk in the price.

CoreWeave’s share price fell to a new low since May 2025 in early trade on Tuesday the 20th, extending a drop of more than 40% that began on Oct. 6. Buying pressure then pushed the price back above Monday’s low of $59.25.

This rebound has the hallmarks of a “short‑squeeze trap,” where the price breaks support and quickly rebounds, hurting traders betting on further declines. However, the signal is only confirmed if the price closes above $59.25.
The cost of default protection on CoreWeave’s debt is sending an even more pessimistic signal.

According to Bloomberg data, the company’s 5‑year credit default swap (CDS) – a contract that pays out if the borrower defaults – closed on Monday the 19th near 1,090 basis points, almost three times last year’s level. That implies roughly a 60% probability of default over the next five years.
This is market pricing, not a forecast. When default‑protection sellers become more nervous they charge higher fees, and the hedge cost is indeed steep.
The market’s worry is that CoreWeave is taking on massive debt to build data centers and then leasing the facilities to AI firms that are also burning cash.
Wall Street Skinny’s Kristen Kelly said bond investors bear all the downside risk but cannot share the upside, “so pricing has to reflect the corresponding risk.”

Siebert Financial’s chief investment officer Mark Malek was even more blunt on the same program, saying some AI stocks “honestly deserve to fall” and adding that he “won’t be adding aggressively at this time.”

However, not everyone thinks the decline will spread. A Bank of America Global Research report described last week’s sharp drop as a “position‑adjustment‑driven blip on the AI‑trading edge,” with the steepest falls seen in “high‑leverage stocks” like CoreWeave and Nebius (NBIS‑US), not the AI giants themselves.
Warning signs could reach more companies
Yet the canary in this mine may be sending a warning to a broader audience.

Monday’s new pressure was not limited to CoreWeave – its debt‑hedge cost has actually slipped slightly from last Friday’s peak, while Oracle’s (ORCL‑US) CDS rose to its highest level since at least 2021 and Meta (META‑US), Amazon (AMZN‑US), Alphabet (GOOGL‑US) and Microsoft (MSFT‑US) all posted multi‑month highs in their credit default swaps.
In other words, the credit market is beginning to spread risk premia to non‑fringe stocks.

For the equity market, the key number to watch is $59.25. Holding that level sustains the short‑squeeze‑trap pattern; bulls then need to retake Monday’s high around $66 before they can aim for the October 15 high near $70.
If the price keeps breaking below Tuesday’s low of $57.24, focus will shift back to the May 2025 low near $53. A breach would open a slide toward the historic low zone of $33‑$36.
Going forward, watch whether the stock price and the default‑protection pricing start to send a consistent signal. One of the two is currently getting it wrong.

items.title: 市場太悲觀了？富國銀行一年多來首亮買訊 看好美股反彈
items.title_en: Is the Market Too Pessimistic? Wells Fargo Issues First Buy Signal in Over a Year, Bullish on US‑Equity Rally
paras: 美股近期受AI投資疑慮與高油價衝擊，富國銀行(WFC-US)的市場情緒指標卻亮起2025年6月以來首次「買進」訊號，顯示投資人可能過度悲觀，股市回檔後已浮現吸引力。不過，該行預期，下一波領漲主角可能轉向大型雲端業者與基礎設施軟體公司，半導體股則可能持續區間震盪。
富國銀行首席股票策略師Ohsung Kwon領軍的團隊指出，歷史上這項指標發出買進訊號後，標普500指數未來三個月上漲的機率達89%，平均漲幅為6.5%。這是一項反向指標，近期訊號反映市場已出現「極度悲觀」情緒。
Kwon認為，投資人對AI融資、期中選舉與伊朗局勢的擔憂，可能已過度反映在市場情緒中。不過，在獲利成長放緩、流動性環境不利的情況下，仍須保持審慎。
截至周一收盤，標普500指數距離歷史高點僅下跌1.6%，但AI相關類股承受的賣壓明顯更重。隨著晶片需求疑慮再起，費城半導體指數自10月6日以來已下跌14%。大型AI企業將於本周與下周陸續公布財報，成為市場檢視成長前景的重要依據。
Kwon已在9月將科技類股評等由「加碼」調降至「中立」，部分原因是期中選舉前，資料中心建設面臨愈來愈多反對聲浪。如今情緒指標轉為買進訊號，並不代表他看好所有AI相關股票同步反彈，而是預期市場領漲結構將有所改變。
過去幾季，AI資本支出超出預期，往往能推升晶片股，但Kwon認為，這種模式未必能繼續成為後市上漲的主要理由。支出愈高，意味企業可能需要發行更多債券，進而排擠專注AI市場的新興雲端業者融資空間。
他指出，未來支撐股價的關鍵將是資本紀律，也就是企業能否更審慎配置投資、控制支出，大型雲端業者有望成為新的領漲族群。相較於單純追逐擴張規模，市場將更重視企業投資與財務管理的能力。
對AI基礎設施的中期前景，Kwon仍抱持正面看法。他認為，2027年將是支撐這個領域投資前景的關鍵，屆時獲利預料維持強勁，供需也將持續吃緊。
paras_en: US equities have recently been hit by AI‑investment doubts and high oil prices, yet Wells Fargo’s (WFC‑US) market‑sentiment indicator flashed a “buy” signal for the first time since June 2025, suggesting investors may be overly gloomy and that the market is gaining appeal after the pull‑back. The bank, however, expects the next rally leaders to shift toward large cloud providers and infrastructure‑software firms, with semiconductor stocks likely to remain in a range‑bound pattern.

The team led by Wells Fargo chief equity strategist Ohsung Kwon notes that historically, when this indicator issues a buy signal, the S&P 500 has an 89% chance of rising over the next three months, with an average gain of 6.5%. It is a contrarian gauge, and the recent signal reflects “extreme pessimism” in the market.

Kwon believes investors have over‑reacted to concerns about AI financing, the mid‑term elections and the situation in Iran, but cautions that a slowdown in earnings growth and a tougher liquidity environment still call for prudence.

As of Monday’s close, the S&P 500 was down only 1.6% from its all‑time high, yet AI‑related stocks faced noticeably heavier selling pressure. With renewed doubts over chip demand, the Philadelphia Semiconductor Index has fallen 14% since October 6. Large AI firms will release earnings this week and next, providing a key barometer for growth outlooks.

Kwon downgraded his rating on technology stocks from “overweight” to “neutral” in September, partly because data‑center construction faced growing opposition ahead of the mid‑term elections. The shift of the sentiment indicator to a buy signal does not mean he expects all AI‑related stocks to rebound together, but rather that the market’s leading‑stock structure is likely to change.

In recent quarters, AI capital spending has exceeded expectations and often lifted chip stocks, but Kwon doubts that this pattern will continue to drive future gains. Higher spending means companies may need to issue more bonds, which could crowd out financing for emerging cloud players focused on the AI market.

He points out that the key to supporting stock prices going forward will be capital discipline – whether firms can allocate investments more cautiously and control outlays – and that large cloud providers are poised to become the new rally leaders. Compared with a pure chase of scale, the market will place greater emphasis on a company’s investment acumen and financial‑management capability.

Regarding the medium‑term outlook for AI infrastructure, Kwon remains upbeat. He sees 2027 as a pivotal year for the sector’s investment case, expecting strong earnings and continued tight supply‑demand dynamics to underpin growth.

items.title: 木頭姐AI股換手 砸813萬美元加碼CoreWeave、減持Palantir
items.title_en: Cathie Wood's AI Stock Turnover: Adds $8.13 M to CoreWeave, Cuts Palantir
paras: 「木頭姐」伍德（Cathie Wood）旗下方舟投資（ARK Invest）10月19日公布最新ETF交易紀錄，持續加碼AI雲端運算公司CoreWeave(CRWV-US) ，單日買進約813萬美元，為當日最大買進交易。
伍德同時減碼Palantir(PLTR-US) 、Shopify(SHOP-US) 及生技公司Personalis(PSNL-US) ，合計賣出約1,137.7萬美元，並增持三家新興生技公司。
根據交易紀錄，ARK透過旗艦創新ETF(ARKK-US) 及新世代網路ETF(ARKW-US) ，合計買進CoreWeave股票132,498股，交易金額約813.41萬美元，延續過去一週持續增持的操作。
CoreWeave主要提供AI訓練與推論所需的雲端運算基礎設施。近期受AI資料中心融資成本上升，以及市場擔憂資本支出回報影響，該公司股價波動加劇，ARK仍持續擴大持股。
賣出方面，ARK當日最大一筆交易為透過基因體學ETF(ARKG-US) ，賣出生技公司Personalis股票284,063股，交易金額約444.56萬美元，延續先前多個交易日削減持股的操作。
ARK另賣出電商軟體公司Shopify股票20,755股，交易金額約351.84萬美元；減持數據分析與AI軟體公司Palantir股票18,349股，交易金額約341.35萬美元。
三家公司合計賣出金額約1,137.7萬美元，高於當日買進CoreWeave的金額。
此外，ARK透過金融科技ETF(ARKF-US) 賣出阿里巴巴(BABA-US) 200股，交易金額約2.18萬美元，並減持線上博弈業者DraftKings(DKNG-US) 股票500股，交易金額約9,450美元。
除了CoreWeave，ARK當日也增加對新興生技公司的投資，透過ARKG買進Iambic Therapeutics(IAM-US) 股票60,269股，交易金額約143.5萬美元；增持Scribe Therapeutics(SCTX-US) 股票19,856股，交易金額約39.87萬美元。
ARK另買進Freenome(PCSC-US) 股票4,835股，交易金額約5.68萬美元，延續先前多個交易日的增持趨勢。上述三家生技公司合計買進金額約189.05萬美元。
paras_en: On October 19, Cathie Wood’s ARK Invest released its latest ETF trading record, showing a continued increase in its stake in AI cloud‑computing firm CoreWeave (CRWV‑US), buying roughly $8.13 million worth in a single day – the largest purchase that day.

Wood also reduced holdings in Palantir (PLTR‑US), Shopify (SHOP‑US) and biotech firm Personalis (PSNL‑US), selling about $11.377 million in total, while adding positions in three emerging biotech companies.

According to the trade logs, ARK bought 132,498 shares of CoreWeave through its flagship Innovation ETF (ARKK‑US) and Next‑Generation Internet ETF (ARKW‑US), amounting to approximately $8.1341 million, continuing a week‑long buying streak.

CoreWeave provides the cloud‑computing infrastructure needed for AI training and inference. Recently, higher financing costs for AI data centers and market worries about capital‑expenditure returns have heightened the stock’s volatility, yet ARK kept expanding its stake.

On the sell side, ARK’s biggest single trade that day came via its Genomics ETF (ARKG‑US), off‑loading 284,063 shares of Personalis for about $4.4456 million, extending a multi‑day reduction in that holding.
ARK also sold 20,755 shares of e‑commerce software company Shopify for roughly $3.5184 million and trimmed 18,349 shares of data‑analytics and AI software firm Palantir for about $3.4135 million.
The three companies together accounted for about $11.377 million in sales, exceeding the amount spent on CoreWeave that day.

In addition, ARK’s FinTech ETF (ARKF‑US) sold 200 shares of Alibaba (BABA‑US) for roughly $21,800 and reduced its position in online gambling operator DraftKings (DKNG‑US) by 500 shares, a trade worth about $9,450.

Beyond CoreWeave, ARK increased its exposure to emerging biotech on the same day, buying 60,269 shares of Iambic Therapeutics (IAM‑US) through ARKG for about $1.435 million and adding 19,856 shares of Scribe Therapeutics (SCTX‑US) for roughly $398,700.
ARK also purchased 4,835 shares of Freenome (PCSC‑US) for about $56,800, continuing a multi‑day buying trend; the three biotech purchases total approximately $1.8905 million.

items.title: 〈台幣〉外資提款台股並匯出一度重貶2.27角 失守32.6元關卡
items.title_en: Foreign Investors Pull Out, Taiwan Stocks and Currency Both Plunge; TWD Briefly Drops 0.227 NTD, Losing the 32.6‑NTD Barrier
paras: 股匯雙殺再現，三大法人今(20)日合計賣超台股968.04億元，外資及陸資賣超795.4億元，台北外匯市場新台幣兌美元終場收在32.617元，重貶1.72角，成交金額達32.77億美元；元太外匯市場成交金額為9.995億美元。兩大外匯市場今日成交金額合計高達 42.765 億美元，顯示在熱錢急退與避險結匯需求湧現下，匯市交投異常熱絡。
新台幣今日以32.48元開出，盤中最高32.48元，隨後受外資擴大匯出影響，一度衝破32.67元關卡，盤中下探至32.672元，最低重貶2.27角，全日維持弱勢重貶格局。
從國際盤與總體環境觀察，雖然美股科技族群昨日出現逢低買盤，帶動那斯達克與費城半導體指數反彈，但亞幣整體維持弱勢格局，直接加重了新台幣的走貶壓力。市場資金在區域資產間快速挪移，外資於台股及匯市同步進行提款操作，形成匯市盤中沉重的下行連動壓力。
在台股與籌碼面部分，根據臺灣證券交易所統計數據，台股今日受電子權值股走弱影響，終場下跌529.15點，收在46292.93點，成交金額為7586.84億元。三大法人今日合計賣超台股968.04億元，其中外資及陸資賣超795.4億元，自營商賣超355.79億元，僅投信逆勢買超183.15億元，顯示外資大舉提款並將資金轉匯出境，是引發今日股匯雙殺的核心因素。
觀察市場後續演變，匯銀人士與市場專家分析指出，新台幣短線能否止貶回穩，完全取決於美股財報週表現及外資提款動作是否放緩。目前新台幣匯率陷於32.6元拉鋸戰，若熱錢匯出趨勢短期內未能平息，匯市不排除進一步回測32.8元關卡。
paras_en: The double blow to stocks and the foreign exchange market reappeared today, with the three major institutional investors collectively selling NT$96.804 billion of Taiwan equities. Foreign and mainland Chinese investors accounted for a net sell of NT$79.54 billion. The Taipei FX market closed at NT$32.617 per US $, a depreciation of 0.172 NTD, with a turnover of US$3.277 billion; the Yuan‑Tai FX market saw a turnover of US$0.9995 billion. Combined, the two FX markets handled US$4.2765 billion, indicating unusually vigorous trading amid a rapid outflow of hot money and a surge in hedging demand.

The New Taiwan dollar opened at NT$32.48 and peaked at NT$32.48 intraday. It then slipped as foreign investors accelerated outflows, briefly breaching the NT$32.67 barrier and falling to NT$32.672, a low that represented a 0.227 NTD weakening. The currency remained in a weak, depreciating stance throughout the session.

Looking at the international markets and the broader environment, U.S. tech stocks rallied yesterday, lifting the Nasdaq and the Philadelphia Semiconductor Index. However, Asian currencies stayed weak overall, adding pressure to the TWD’s decline. Capital shifted quickly among regional assets, and foreign investors withdrew from both Taiwan equities and the FX market simultaneously, creating a heavy downward linkage in the currency market.

On the equity side, Taiwan Stock Exchange data show that the market was dragged down by weaker electronic‑sector leaders, closing down 529.15 points at 46,292.93 with a turnover of NT$758.684 billion. The three major institutional investors sold a total of NT$96.804 billion of stocks, of which foreign and mainland investors net‑sold NT$79.54 billion, proprietary traders sold NT$35.579 billion, while only mutual funds bought NT$18.315 billion against the trend. The large‑scale foreign outflow and capital repatriation were the core drivers of today’s stock‑FX double‑hit.

Looking ahead, FX analysts and market experts say the short‑term fate of the TWD hinges on U.S. earnings reports and whether foreign capital withdrawals ease. The TWD is currently locked in a tug‑of‑war around the NT$32.6 level; if hot‑money outflows persist, the market could test the NT$32.8 barrier further downwards.

◆EUR/USD
澳洲央行(RBA)助理總裁肯特指出，勞動力市場寬鬆的速度快於預期，但他警告不要過度解讀單月數據，另外中國第三季國內生產總值(GDP)增長4.5%，且9月零售銷售成長1.1%，皆超過預期，緩解了決策者實施更激進刺激措施的壓力，並為全球經濟增長帶來利好，為澳幣、紐元提供支撐，歐元兌美元觸及1.1234高點。
由於法國各地爆發大規模因物價上漲和公共服務惡化引發的抗議活動，凸顯政府在削減赤字方面面臨困難，加劇市場對其財政日益惡化的擔憂，與此同時，西班牙極左翼政黨分別推出各自的候選人參加選舉，降低了社會黨籍首相桑契斯繼續領導左翼聯合政府執政的可能性，加劇了政治前景不確定性，打擊歐元兌美元至1.1180低點。預估今日歐元兌美元支撐於1.1160-80，阻力於1.1230-50。
◆GBP/USD

週末法國主要城市騷亂影響以及烏克蘭戰爭升級打擊歐元走勢，兌英鎊跌至17個月低點，激勵英鎊兌美元漲至1.3341高點。隨後據英國房地產網站Rightmove公布10月新掛牌出售房產要價較前月上漲1%，但有跡象顯示，受伊朗戰爭影響而走高的抵押貸款利率，開始削弱購屋負擔能力，並對市場中原本較具韌性的部分造成壓力，推低英鎊兌美元1.3295低點。預估今日英鎊兌美元支撐於1.3250-70，阻力於1.3330-50。

U.S. President Trump decided to waive certain sanctions and tariffs on Russia, which could boost Russian fuel exports and push international oil prices lower. According to CME's FedWatch tool, federal funds futures pricing shows an 87% probability that the Federal Reserve will keep the U.S. dollar interest rate unchanged at its October 28 policy meeting. He reiterated the need to keep core inflation around 2%, indicating the BOJ still has room for further rate hikes. With the BOJ concluding its two‑day policy meeting on October 30, many market participants expect the bank to leave its policy rate at 1.25% unchanged, but the post‑meeting statement could signal room to raise rates to 1.5% as early as December. Prime Minister Kishida also said Japan will moderate the scale of debt issuance and strengthen the economy to boost investor confidence in the yen, providing yen support and keeping USD/JPY flat around the low of 157.68.

The drop reflects higher mortgage rates and rising prices for energy‑related building materials due to Middle‑East conflict. However, as investors' concerns about rate‑driven AI impacts eased, U.S. Treasury yields rose, with the benchmark 10‑year yield rebounding from its biggest weekly decline in seven months, pushing USD/JPY up to a high of 158.54. At the same time, Spain’s far‑left parties have each put forward their own candidates for upcoming elections, reducing the likelihood that Socialist Prime Minister Sánchez can continue leading a left‑wing coalition government and adding political uncertainty. items.title: 〈紐約匯市〉美元走強 法國動亂與暴力抗議拖累歐元
items.title_en: <New York Forex> Dollar Strengthens as French Unrest and Violent Protests Drag Down Euro
paras: 美元周一(19日)走強，主要受到歐元下跌，以及美國債券市場再度出現拋售潮的推動。
紐約尾盤，追蹤美元兌六種主要貨幣的美元指數(DXY)上漲0.2%，報102。此前，美元指數出現近五週以來首次單週下跌，主要因市場對美國聯準會（Fed）短期內升息的預期略微降溫。
法國陷入動盪
美國及全球外匯市場的參與者，正密切關注法國局勢不斷升級的情況。
作為歐元區第二大經濟體，法國週末爆發大規模暴力抗議，民眾不滿生活成本飆升，以及公共服務經費不足。同時，法國本身也正面臨財政危機。
法國各城市有數千人與警方發生衝突，部分商店遭到洗劫，造成近年來最嚴重社會動亂之一。暴力事件進一步加大法國總統馬克宏（Emmanuel Macron）政治壓力。在 2027 年任期結束前，他的施政已因日益高漲的社會不滿情緒而陷入愈發嚴重的停滯。
由於法國政府公債（OAT）表現落後，而透過信用違約交換（CDS）為法國主權債務投保的成本也升至多年高點，法國公債與德國聯邦公債（Bund）之間的利差進一步擴大，對歐元構成直接的基本面壓力。
歐元兌美元下跌 0.3%，至 1.1210 美元。
Macquarie全球外匯與利率策略師 Thierry Wizman 表示，「法國的社會局勢可能帶來一種和平且具宣洩效果的改變，例如透過提高退休年齡來推動緊縮政策，前提是民主制度能夠維持穩定。然而，真正可能引發轉變的 2027 年大選，對大多數交易員而言仍太遙遠。他們更擔心的是未來幾週的局勢發展。」
他進一步指出，「只要電視畫面持續出現混亂景象，市場就傾向於賣出歐元，並推高法國主權債務利差。如果法國出現存款外流，將可能促使歐洲央行（ECB）介入，而這很可能進一步削弱歐元。」
法國 10 年期公債殖利率週一大幅上升，債券拋售壓力也蔓延至美國市場。
美國 10 年期公債殖利率上升 4.5 個基點，來到 5.145%。對利率政策較為敏感的 2 年期公債殖利率則上升 4 個基點，來到 4.776%。
日元走弱 加幣走強
日元走弱，美元兌日元升至 158.53。
日本當局先前已與美國釋出聯合警告訊號，外匯交易部門對東京當局可能在目前價位進場干預匯市，仍保持高度警戒。
日本銀行（BoJ）總裁植田和男(Kazuo Ueda)在公開談話中表示，日本的基礎通膨正穩步接近央行設定的 2% 目標。
植田的發言進一步強化市場預期：央行仍將循序漸進地推動貨幣政策正常化。因此，利率市場持續關注日銀今年稍晚可能採取的貨幣政策調整。
另一方面，印尼盾終於停止連續四個交易日的跌勢。在這波下跌期間，印尼盾一度貶至 1 美元兌 18,063 印尼盾，創下近三個月來最低。
這波拋售潮起因是 MSCI 提議調降印尼股票市場評級，理由是印尼市場長期存在外資進入不易及公司治理方面的疑慮。
這項提議引發印尼雅加達綜合指數單日暴跌 11.6%，創下 1998 年亞洲金融風暴以來最大單日跌幅。
其他市場方面，加拿大幣兌美元走強，美元兌加拿大元跌至 1.4110。
加拿大消費者通膨加速，提升了市場對加拿大央行(BoC)可能採取較強硬貨幣政策的預期。
根據加拿大統計局公布數據，加拿大 9 月消費者物價指數（CPI）年增率為 3.1%，低於經濟學家預估的 3.2%，但高於 8 月的 3.0%。
此外，這也是加拿大 CPI 連續三個月上升後，首次超出加拿大央行設定的 1% 至 3% 通膨目標區間。
本次 CPI 上升主要受到能源價格推動。能源價格年增 19%，其中汽油價格更大幅上漲 27.8%。
加拿大央行總裁 Tiff Macklem 已表示，通膨可能進一步上升。儘管他也指出，目前還沒有太多證據顯示，價格壓力已經擴散至其他商品與服務。

paras_en: The dollar strengthened on Monday (the 19th), mainly driven by a falling euro and a renewed wave of selling in the U.S. bond market.

In the New York close, the dollar index (DXY), which tracks the greenback against six major currencies, rose 0.2% to 102. Earlier, the index had posted its first weekly decline in nearly five weeks, as expectations for near‑term Fed rate hikes cooled slightly.
France in Turmoil
Market participants in the U.S. and global FX markets are watching the escalating situation in France closely.

As the euro‑area’s second‑largest economy, France saw massive violent protests over the weekend, with citizens angry about soaring living costs and underfunded public services, while the country also faces a fiscal crisis.

Thousands clashed with police in cities across France, some shops were looted, creating one of the most severe social upheavals in recent years. The violence adds political pressure on President Emmanuel Macron, whose agenda is increasingly stalled by rising social discontent ahead of the end of his term in 2027.

Because French government bonds (OAT) have underperformed and the cost of insuring French sovereign debt via credit‑default swaps (CDS) has risen to multi‑year highs, the spread between French OATs and German Bunds has widened, putting direct fundamental pressure on the euro.
The euro fell 0.3% against the dollar to $1.1210.

Macquarie global FX and rates strategist Thierry Wizman said, “France’s social situation could lead to a peaceful, venting‑type change, such as raising the retirement age to push a tightening agenda, provided the democratic system remains stable. However, the real catalyst – the 2027 election – is still too far away for most traders. They are more concerned about how the situation develops over the next few weeks.”

He added, “As long as TV screens keep showing chaos, markets tend to sell euros and push French sovereign spreads higher. If France sees capital outflows, the European Central Bank may step in, which could further weaken the euro.”
French 10‑year bond yields jumped sharply on Monday, and bond‑selling pressure spread to the U.S. market.
U.S. 10‑year Treasury yields rose 4.5 basis points to 5.145%, while the more rate‑sensitive 2‑year yield climbed 4 basis points to 4.776%.
Yen Weakens, Canadian Dollar Strengthens
The yen weakened as the dollar rose to ¥158.53.
Japanese authorities have previously signaled a joint warning with the United States, and the FX trading desk remains on high alert for possible intervention by Tokyo officials at current levels.
Bank of Japan Governor Kazuo Ueda said in a public remarks that Japan’s core inflation is steadily moving toward the central bank’s 2% target.
Ueda’s comments reinforced market expectations that the BOJ will continue a gradual normalization of monetary policy, keeping rate markets focused on potential policy adjustments later this year.
On the other hand, the Indonesian rupiah finally halted a four‑day losing streak. During the decline it had slipped to IDR 18,063 per dollar, a three‑month low.
The sell‑off was sparked by an MSCI proposal to downgrade Indonesia’s equity market rating, citing long‑standing difficulties for foreign investors and corporate‑governance concerns.
The proposal triggered an 11.6% single‑day plunge in the Jakarta Composite Index, the biggest daily drop since the 1998 Asian financial crisis.
In other markets, the Canadian dollar rose against the dollar, with USD/CAD slipping to 1.4110.
Canadian consumer inflation accelerated, raising expectations that the Bank of Canada may adopt a tighter policy stance.
Statistics Canada reported that September’s CPI rose 3.1% year‑over‑year, below the 3.2% forecast but above August’s 3.0%.
It also marked the first time in three months that Canada’s CPI moved above the BoC’s 1%‑3% target range.
The CPI increase was mainly driven by energy prices, which rose 19% year‑over‑year, with gasoline jumping 27.8%.
Bank of Canada Governor Tiff Macklem said inflation could rise further, though he noted there is still limited evidence that price pressures have spread to other goods and services.

items.title: 〈台幣〉熱錢持續流出 重貶1.07角收32.445元
items.title_en: TWD: Hot Money Continues to Flow Out, Depreciates 0.107 to Close at 32.445
paras: 台北金融市場今(19) 日「股匯雙殺」再現，受到美股震盪及國際避險情緒升溫影響，外資持續大舉撤資，三大法人合計賣超台股899.54億元，加權指數一度重挫941點，台積電 (2330-TW) (TSM-US) 等權值股尾盤急拉，終場下跌289.18點，收在46822.08點。匯市在資金大量淨匯出壓力下，新台幣兌美元匯率開低走低，盤中一度觸及32.572元低點，終場重貶1.07角收在32.445元，兩大外匯市場爆出38.53億美元的大量。
觀察台股法人動態，三大法人今日資金操作分歧明顯。外資及陸資延續偏空態度，單日賣超高達767.43億元，寫下連續9個交易日賣超紀錄；自營商也站在賣方，賣超362.63億元；僅投信法人獨撐大局，逆勢買超230.51億元，展現強烈護盤意願。
今日台股籌碼面持續出現調節，導致大盤開盤即遭重挫，盤中最低下探46170點，考驗季線支撐，所幸尾盤台積電等半導體族群拉回平盤，帶動指數跌幅收斂。
匯市方面，新台幣兌美元開盤價為32.36元，隨後受外資強勁匯出買賣盤衝擊，匯價一路下探，早盤最高僅達32.36元，盤中最低重摔至32.572元。面對外資短時間大幅撤離，中央銀行盤中罕見緊急發布聲明穩固信心，並適時進場拋匯提供美元流動性。終場台北外匯市場新台幣收在32.445元，貶值1.07角；成交金額則擴大至28.31億美元。
元太外匯市場新台幣收盤價則為32.468元，貶值1.2角，成交金額為10.22億美元。兩大匯市合計成交金額衝高至38.53億美元，顯示市場交投極為熱絡且多空對峙激烈。
paras_en: Taipei's financial markets saw a repeat of the "stock‑currency double kill" today (19th) as US equity volatility and rising global risk‑off sentiment prompted foreign investors to pull out large amounts of capital. The three major institutional investors collectively sold a net 89.954 billion TWD of Taiwanese equities, and the weighted index plunged as much as 941 points before ending down 289.18 points at 46,822.08. Meanwhile, under heavy net outflows in the foreign exchange market, the New Taiwan dollar weakened against the US dollar, briefly hitting a low of 32.572 TWD per USD before closing down 0.107 to 32.445, with the two major FX markets reporting a combined outflow of $3.853 billion.

Looking at the activity of Taiwan's institutional investors, today's fund flows showed a clear divergence. Foreign and mainland Chinese investors maintained a bearish stance, net selling a record 76.743 billion TWD in a single day, marking the ninth consecutive trading day of net outflows. Proprietary traders also sold, netting 36.263 billion TWD. Only investment trusts stood on the buying side, net purchasing 23.051 billion TWD, demonstrating a strong willingness to support the market.

The market's capital structure continued to adjust today, causing the index to tumble sharply at the open and dip to a intraday low of 46,170 points, testing the seasonal (quarterly) support line. Fortunately, semiconductor stocks such as TSMC rallied in the closing minutes, pulling the index back toward the flat line and narrowing the overall decline.

In the FX market, the TWD opened at 32.36 per USD but was quickly pressured lower by strong foreign outflows, falling to a low of 32.572 during the session. Facing a rapid, large‑scale withdrawal of foreign capital, the central bank issued a rare emergency statement mid‑session to steady confidence and intervened by selling dollars to provide liquidity. The Taipei foreign‑exchange market closed the TWD at 32.445, a depreciation of 0.107, with transaction volume expanding to $2.831 billion.

The Yuan‑Tai foreign‑exchange market closed the TWD at 32.468, a depreciation of 0.12, with a transaction volume of $1.022 billion. Combined, the two major FX markets saw total turnover rise to $3.853 billion, indicating extremely active trading and fierce battles between buyers and sellers.

items.title: 印尼股票市場拋售加劇 並蔓延至債券與印尼盾
items.title_en: Indonesia Stock Market Sell‑Off Intensifies and Spreads to Bonds and Rupiah
paras: 印尼雅加達綜合指數(JCI)持續下挫，周一(19日)盤中一度重挫5.4%，延續上周五崩跌12%的頹勢。此次下跌，主要受到指數編算公司摩根士丹利資本國際(MSCI Inc.)發出潛在降級警告影響。
相關衝擊造成印尼金融市場拋售潮全面擴大，股市陷入近30年來最嚴重暴跌，賣壓並迅速延燒至債券與印尼盾匯市。
MSCI 上周五表示，出於可投資性等疑慮，正考慮將印尼從「新興市場」直接降級至「獨立市場」，此舉遠超今年1月警示降至「邊境市場」的幅度。措手不及的印尼官方已安排於周一與 MSCI 高層會面尋求釐清。
高盛估算，若印尼被完全剔除，可能觸發約56億美元的被動型資金撤出，若富時羅素(FTSE Russell)跟進，恐再面臨27億美元流出風險。2026年截至目前，外資已從印尼股市淨撤出51億美元，創下歷史最大年度外流紀錄。
針對市場崩盤與資金外逃，新加坡東斯銀行(SEB)亞洲策略主管 Eugenia Victorino 指出：「外資正全線撤離印尼股市，債市也感受到熱度。印尼盾走弱正侵蝕實質殖利率，在匯率止穩前，全球資金寧可安全地位於場外觀望。」
PT MNC Sekuritas 分析師 Herditya Wicaksana 表示：「賣壓依然顯著，特別是像大型銀行這類對雅加達綜合指數影響巨大的股票。」
星展集團(DBS Group) 警告，衝擊可能進一步蔓延並緊縮融資條件，推升10年期國債殖利率邁向7.5%，並促使印尼央行再升息50至100個基點。
為遏止跌勢，印尼證券交易所周一緊急調緊單一股票每日最大跌幅限制，由15%縮減至7%，施行至今年底
。企業端也展開自救，富豪 Prajogo Pangestu 旗下三家公司計畫合計買回2.5兆印尼盾(約1.38億美元)庫藏股；金光集團旗下 PT Dian Swastatika Sentosa 也提議買回1兆印尼盾股票。
paras_en: Indonesia’s Jakarta Composite Index (JCI) kept sliding, plunging as much as 5.4% during Monday’s (the 19th) session, extending the 12% crash that began last Friday. The drop was mainly triggered by a potential downgrade warning issued by the index‑calculating firm MSCI Inc.

The fallout sparked a broad sell‑off across Indonesia’s financial markets, with the equity market experiencing its steepest plunge in nearly 30 years and selling pressure quickly spilling over into bonds and the rupiah foreign‑exchange market.

MSCI said on Friday that, due to concerns over investability, it is considering moving Indonesia from the “Emerging Markets” category directly to “Standalone Market,” a step far beyond the warning in January that it might be demoted to a “Frontier Market.” Caught off guard, Indonesian officials have arranged a meeting with senior MSCI officials on Monday to seek clarification.

Goldman Sachs estimates that a full removal of Indonesia could trigger about $5.6 billion of passive‑fund outflows, and if FTSE Russell follows suit, another $2.7 billion could flee. To date in 2026, foreign investors have net‑withdrawn $5.1 billion from Indonesia’s stock market, setting a record for the largest annual outflow.

Commenting on the market crash and capital flight, Eugenia Victorino, head of Asian strategy at Singapore’s SEB, said: “Foreign investors are pulling out of Indonesian equities across the board, and the bond market is feeling the heat. A weaker rupiah is eroding real yields, and until the currency stabilises, global capital would rather stay safely off‑exchange and wait.”
Herditya Wicaksana, an analyst at PT MNC Sekuritas, noted: “Selling pressure remains significant, especially in stocks like large banks that have a huge impact on the Jakarta Composite Index.”

DBS Group warned that the shock could spread further and tighten financing conditions, pushing the 10‑year government bond yield toward 7.5% and prompting the Bank of Indonesia to raise rates by another 50 to 100 basis points.

To curb the decline, the Indonesia Stock Exchange on Monday urgently tightened the daily maximum price‑move limit for individual stocks, cutting it from 15% to 7% effective through the end of the year.

Companies are also taking self‑help measures: billionaire Prajogo Pangestu’s three firms plan to repurchase a total of 2.5 trillion rupiah (about $138 million) of shares, and PT Dian Swastatika Sentosa of the Golden Light Group has proposed buying back 1 trillion rupiah of stock.

items.title: 人工智慧浪潮助推 馬來西亞9月出口額創逾5年新高
items.title_en: AI Wave Boosts Malaysia's September Export Value to Over Five-Year High
paras: 受惠於全球人工智慧(AI)浪潮與資料中心建置帶動的半導體及電子產品需求，馬來西亞今年9月外貿展現強勁成長力道，出口額刷新逾5年來最高紀錄。
根據馬來西亞統計局(DOSM)與投資貿易暨工業部(MITI)公布的最新數據，馬來西亞9月出口額達2,151億令吉(約合450億美元)，年增54.5%，表現遠超出《路透》調查預期的44.6%及《彭博》預估的39.9%。
在進出口同步雙位數成長帶動下，9月總貿易額年增53.7%至3,965億令吉。進口額則年增52.7%至1,814億令吉，高於市場預期的39%，9月貿易順差擴大約65%至337億令吉，高於預期的316億令吉。
統計局資料顯示，進口擴張主要由生產輸入端需求強勁所推升，其中中間財進口大增69.6%至921億令吉，資本財與消費財進口亦分別成長20.9%及18.2%。
從主要出口商品來看，占總出口半數以上的電子與電器產品(E&E)9月出口額年增率高達68%至69.2%，創下單月歷史新高。包含半導體測試儀器在內的光學與科學設備出口額亦同步登頂。
出口市場方面，對台灣出口年增率高達175.2%(成長超過一倍)，對美國出口成長89.9%，對中國出口則成長22.1%。相對地，受棕櫚油出口減少拖累，農業出口年減5.7%。
針對未來外貿展望，馬來西亞投資貿工部在官方聲明中特別警示：「馬來西亞的貿易表現仍面臨主要經濟體貿易政策轉變及地緣政治緊張局勢帶來的不確定性。」
MITI 分析，尤其是中東地區持續的衝突可能打亂全球貿易流動並加劇成本壓力。MITI 表示未來將持續「評估相關發展、加強市場多元化、擴大進入高成長市場，並協助馬來西亞出口商進行調整」，以增強外貿抗風險能力。
paras_en: Benefiting from the global artificial intelligence (AI) wave and the demand for semiconductors and electronic products driven by data‑center construction, Malaysia’s foreign trade showed strong growth in September, with export value reaching a record high not seen in more than five years.

According to the latest data released by Malaysia’s Department of Statistics (DOSM) and the Ministry of International Trade and Industry (MITI), September export value hit RM215.1 billion (about US$45 billion), up 54.5% year‑on‑year, far exceeding Reuters’ forecast of 44.6% and Bloomberg’s estimate of 39.9%.

With both imports and exports posting double‑digit growth, total trade in September rose 53.7% year‑on‑year to RM396.5 billion. Imports increased 52.7% to RM181.4 billion, above the market’s 39% expectation, and the trade surplus widened about 65% to RM33.7 billion, higher than the anticipated RM31.6 billion.

Statistics show that the import expansion was mainly driven by strong demand for production inputs, with intermediate goods imports surging 69.6% to RM92.1 billion, while capital goods and consumer goods imports grew 20.9% and 18.2% respectively.

Looking at major export commodities, electronic and electrical (E&E) products, which account for more than half of total exports, posted a year‑on‑year growth of 68% to RM69.2 billion, setting a new monthly historical high. Exports of optical and scientific equipment, including semiconductor testing instruments, also hit record levels.

In terms of export markets, shipments to Taiwan jumped 175.2% year‑on‑year (more than double), to the United States grew 89.9%, and to China rose 22.1%. Conversely, agricultural exports fell 5.7% year‑on‑year due to a drop in palm‑oil shipments.

Regarding the outlook, MITI warned in an official statement that “Malaysia’s trade performance still faces uncertainty from major economies’ shifting trade policies and heightened geopolitical tensions.”

MITI analysis notes that ongoing conflicts in the Middle East could disrupt global trade flows and increase cost pressures. It said Malaysia will continue to “assess developments, strengthen market diversification, expand entry into high‑growth markets, and help exporters adjust,” to boost the resilience of its foreign trade.

美國聯邦準備理事會(FED)主席沃什雖對美國經濟韌性表示樂觀，且稱受益人工智能推動，並向其他領域擴展的投資熱潮，正引發短期需求衝擊，從而對通脹形成上行壓力，但拒絕透露關於今年剩餘時間的會議上可能採取的行動，使得美元承壓；此外，日本央行(BOJ)總裁植田和男表示，確保基礎通脹率穩定在BOJ 2%的通脹目標附近正變得越來越重要，且據路透公布一項調查顯示，隨著中東衝突推動能源價格上漲的影響正逐步傳導至家庭，日本9月核心消費者通脹率可能自12月以來首次超過BOJ 2%的目標，另外美國財政部次長Erin Browne指出，日本已不再面臨持續十餘年的通縮環境，其匯率水平與貨幣政策必須相應調整，並隨著日本投資人截至10月10日當週連續第四週淨賣出外國債券，延續了撤離海外債市的趨勢，提供日圓支撐，令美元兌日圓下降至157.67低點。

隨後據美國官方公布9月數據顯示，工業生產及製造業產出分別成長0.7%及0.3%，且衡量企業資源利用程度的產能利用率升至76.9%，另外進口及出口物價月率漲幅分別為1.1%及2.2%，皆超過市場預期，且進口物價同比上漲8.1%，漲幅為2022年7月以來最大，這進一步表明，隨著中東衝突持續，美國國內通脹壓力正在加劇，推動美元兌日圓走升至158.33高點。預估今日美元兌日圓阻力於158.10-30，支撐於157.30-50。
◆EUR/USD

澳洲疲軟的就業數據表現，促使投資人下調對澳洲央行(RBA)今年第五次加息的押注，拖累澳幣走勢，但相較於紐西蘭央行(RBNZ)首席經濟學家康韋在接受彭博新聞採訪時稱下一次利率調整一切皆有可能，隨著調期市場數據顯示，RBNZ在10月28日將利率上調25個基點概率為86%，為紐元提供支撐，而且國際貨幣基金(IMF)預計歐洲央行(ECB)於2026年至少加息25個基點，提振歐元兌美元觸及1.1269高點。
據歐盟統計局公布歐元區9月消費者物價調和指數(HICP)月率及年率分別上升0.6%及3.8%，符合預期，但8月未經季節性調整貿易數據意外錄得逆差161億歐元，且據IMF指出法國借貸成本短期內仍屬可控，但財政整頓壓力恐將加大，打擊歐元兌美元至1.1206低點。預估今日歐元兌美元支撐於1.1190-1.1210，阻力於1.1260-80。
◆GBP/USD

週五英國央行(BOE)總裁貝利於出席國際金融協會(IIF)時表示英國通脹率高於目標水平，但迄今為止，能源價格飆升似乎對英國物價廣泛影響有限，令英鎊兌美元盤整於1.3263低點；隨後美國FED主席沃什未對美國強勁的CPI及PPI數據置評，使得10月FED加息的概率也因沃什的言論而下降，相較於路透調查的多數經濟學家預測，BOE將於11月將指標利率上調至4.0%，這將是該行三年多來的首次加息，激勵英鎊兌美元漲至三週高點1.3371。預估今日英鎊兌美元支撐於1.3290-1.3310，阻力於1.3370-90。

paras_en: USD/JPY

Federal Reserve Chair Jerome Powell expressed optimism about the resilience of the U.S. economy and said that the investment boom spurred by artificial‑intelligence advances and its spill‑over into other sectors is creating short‑term demand pressure that could push inflation higher. He declined to reveal what actions might be taken at the remaining meetings this year, leaving the dollar under pressure. Meanwhile, Bank of Japan Governor Kazuo Ueda said it is becoming increasingly important to keep core‑inflation near the BOJ’s 2% target, and a Reuters poll shows that rising energy prices from the Middle‑East conflict are gradually passing through to households. Japan’s core CPI for September could exceed the BOJ’s 2% goal for the first time since December. U.S. Treasury Deputy Secretary Erin Browne added that Japan is no longer in a decade‑long deflationary environment, so its exchange‑rate level and monetary policy must adjust. Japanese investors have sold foreign bonds for the fourth consecutive week as of the week ending Oct. 10, continuing the pull‑out from overseas bond markets, which supports the yen and pushed USD/JPY down to a low of 157.67.

Subsequent U.S. official data for September showed industrial production up 0.7% and manufacturing output up 0.3%, while capacity utilization rose to 76.9%. Import and export prices rose 1.1% and 2.2% month‑over‑month, both above expectations, and import prices jumped 8.1% year‑over‑year – the biggest rise since July 2022. The figures indicate that, as the Middle‑East conflict persists, domestic inflation pressure in the United States is intensifying, driving the dollar up to a high of 158.33 against the yen. The market expects resistance for USD/JPY around 158.10‑30 and support around 157.30‑50.
EUR/USD

Weak Australian employment data led investors to downgrade bets on a fifth RBA rate hike this year, weighing on the Aussie dollar. By contrast, Reserve Bank of New Zealand chief economist Michael Baker told Bloomberg that any outcome is possible for the next rate move, and market data show an 86% probability that the RBNZ will raise rates by 25 basis points on Oct. 28, supporting the kiwi. The International Monetary Fund also projects that the European Central Bank will lift rates by at least 25 basis points in 2026, helping the euro climb to a high of 1.1269 against the dollar.

Euro‑area CPI data released by Eurostat showed the Harmonised Index of Consumer Prices rising 0.6% month‑over‑month and 3.8% year‑over‑year in September, in line with expectations. However, seasonally‑adjusted trade data for August unexpectedly posted a €16.1 billion deficit. The IMF noted that France’s short‑term borrowing costs remain manageable, but fiscal‑adjustment pressure could increase, pushing EUR/USD down to a low of 1.1206. The market expects support for the euro around 1.1190‑1.1210 and resistance around 1.1260‑1.1280.
GBP/USD

On Friday, Bank of England Governor Andrew Holmes told the International Finance Forum that UK inflation remains above target, but so far the surge in energy prices has had limited broad‑based impact on prices, leaving the pound flat at a low of 1.3263 against the dollar. Later, Fed Chair Jerome Powell did not comment on the strong U.S. CPI and PPI numbers, reducing the perceived probability of an October Fed hike. Most Reuters‑surveyed economists now expect the BOE to raise its policy rate to 4.0% in November – the first hike in more than three years – which could lift GBP/USD to a three‑week high of 1.3371. The market projects support for the pound around 1.3290‑1.3310 and resistance around 1.3370‑1.3390.
